description: Creates an independent note type with the source's ordered fields, card template HTML, and shared CSS. In AnkiConnect v1 it preserves the Browser sort field and requires the reviewed clone hash before applying. Does not copy notes or cards.

dryRun.description: When true, validate and preview the clone without creating a note type

expectedCloneHash.description: Hash returned by the reviewed clone preview; required for apply in v1.

expectedSourceDesignHash.description: Source design hash required for legacy apply; v1 apply requires expectedCloneHash.

isCloze.description: Optional normal/Cloze override. By default the tool detects {{cloze:...}} filters in the source templates.

sourceModelName.description: Existing note type whose ordered fields, templates, CSS, and v1 sort field should be copied

targetModelName.description: Unique name for the new independent note type

name: clone-note-type

sortField.description: Source sort field preserved by v1; null in legacy mode.

sourceDesignHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the current CSS and card templates

title: Clone note type
